seo_description: Find your Simply Enak food tour meeting point in Kuala Lumpur and Penang. Directions to Pasar Seni LRT, Hilton Garden Inn, and George Town meeting points.
hero_description: All our tours start at convenient, easy-to-find meeting points in the heart of each city.

meeting_points.name: Pasar Seni LRT Station (KL)
meeting_points.address: Pasar Seni LRT Station, Jalan Sultan, Kuala Lumpur
meeting_points.description: Meet at Tealive, Pasar Seni LRT Station. The station is on the Kelana Jaya LRT line, one stop from KL Sentral.

meeting_points.name: Hilton Garden Inn KL North (KL)
meeting_points.address: Hilton Garden Inn KL North, 449 Jalan Tuanku Abdul Rahman, Kuala Lumpur
meeting_points.description: Meet at the Hilton Garden Inn KL North lobby. Located in the Chow Kit neighborhood, a 5-minute taxi from KLCC.

meeting_points.name: George Town Meeting Point (Penang)
meeting_points.address: In front of the CHEW JETTY, Weld Quay, George Town, Penang
meeting_points.description: Meet at the entrance of Chew Jetty on Weld Quay. Look for the Simply Enak guide with a blue badge.

general_tips.tip: Arrive 5-10 minutes early so we can start on time
Wear comfortable walking shoes - we'll cover about 2 km
Bring an umbrella or hat for sun/rain protection
Let us know if you're running late via WhatsApp +6 017 287 8929
All meeting points are near public transport and taxi stands
